meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 安装此技能后,NanoClaw 就能接入 DeltaChat(基于邮件的加密聊天)。它通过电子邮件收发消息,用 OpenPGP 加密,并生成邀请链接/二维码让别人加机器人。
howto.when: 当用户要求将 DeltaChat 集成为聊天渠道时触发,常见于 /setup 流程或直接请求添加该频道。

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 添加 DeltaChat 频道
say.note: 将开始安装适配器并引导配置。

say.text: 帮我配置 DeltaChat 的邮箱凭据
say.note: 会提示填写 IMAP/SMTP 设置。

say.text: 生成 DeltaChat 邀请链接二维码
say.note: 会输出链接和二维码供扫码加入。

howto.what_en: Adds DeltaChat channel to NanoClaw: email-based chats with E2E encryption (Autocrypt/OpenPGP), native adapter running the DeltaChat core via JSON-RPC, plus invite link/QR generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to set up a DeltaChat channel, commonly during /setup or by explicitly requesting DeltaChat integration.

say_en.text: Add a DeltaChat channel for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Starts the install and credential setup.
Outputs the invite URL and QR SVG.
